content.title: Burke Schultz Harman & Burke - Personal Injury Attorneys
content.text: West Virginia Personal Injury Attorneys and More The attorneys at Burke, Schultz, Harman & Burke have provided legal services to clients in Martinsburg, West Virginia (WV) and the surrounding Eastern Panhandle area since 1980. Our practice areas include personal injury and wrongful death, medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, and Social Security disability. Our West Virginia personal injury attorneys have a combined experience of nearly 150 years and we know how to secure the compensation and benefits injured parties need and deserve. We have been serving Berkeley, Jefferson, and Morgan Counties and the surrounding areas in West Virginia and Western Maryland for more than 40 years, and we’re ready to fight for you, your rights, and the meaningful compensation you deserve or benefits you are entitled to right now. Tough, Dedicated West Virginia Personal Injury Attorneys When someone is injured or killed as the result of another person or entity’s wrongdoing or neglect, West Virginia personal injury laws provide a legal means to recover compensation for the related financial and personal losses, which can include medical bills, loss of work time or the ability to work, property damage, and pain and suffering. These kinds of injuries can alter the course of people’s lives, and injured individuals and their families are entitled to be “made whole” by the person or entity responsible for the damages. The West Virginia personal injury attorneys at Burke, Schultz, Harman & Burke are tough but compassionate, and we’re committed to getting the job done. Our clients can trust that their Martinsburg personal injury attorney will work steadfastly toward the goal of delivering the highest level of professional services and legal representation that is customized to meet their unique needs. If your injury or that of a loved one resulted from wrongdoing or negligence in medical care, a West Virginia medical malpractice lawyer at Burke, Schultz, Harman & Burke is ready to help you file and fight for appropriate and necessary compensation for your injuries and losses. West Virginia and Maryland residents who are unable to work due to poor health or medical conditions may qualify for Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) benefits. Our WV Social Security lawyers will review your case and, if you are eligible for benefits, pursue your right to SSDI through the courts or other appropriate channels. West Virginia Personal Injury Lawyers for Auto Accidents And More The West Virginia personal injury lawyers at Burke, Schultz, Harman & Burke strive to provide the services our clients need while maintaining a high standard for customer service. We can meet with you on your schedule and are available on evenings and even weekends by appointment. If you are unable to travel to our Martinsburg, West Virginia office due to your injuries or other issues, we can make arrangements to visit you. In a free initial consultation, we will spend time talking with you to understand the details and specifics of your case. Our attorneys generally work for clients on a contingency fee basis, which means no expenses are charged to you until and unless compensation or benefits are recovered on your behalf. Our comprehensive personal injury practice includes all of the following practice areas: Car accidents; Medical malpractice; Motorcycle accidents; Nursing home abuse and neglect; Truck accidents; Serious injuries; Social Security disability; and Wrongful death. Experienced WV Injury Lawyers for West Virginia and Western Maryland Burke, Schultz, Harman & Burke’s attorneys practice in Berkeley, Jefferson, and Morgan counties, including the communities of Berkeley Springs, Charles Town, Hedgesville, Inwood, Martinsburg, and Shepherdstown. Our WV injury lawyers who are licensed in the state of Maryland are proud to provide services to Hagerstown and the surrounding area. Individuals who were injured as a result of someone else’s negligence or wrongdoing and those who are disabled often need legal counsel and representation to secure the compensation and benefits to which they are entitled. If you find yourself in this situation, contact Burke, Schultz, Harman & Burke to schedule a consultation with an experienced West Virginia personal injury attorney. As Your West Virginia Personal Injury Attorneys, We Play Hardball The West Virginia personal injury attorneys at Burke, Schultz, Harman & Burke have served West Virginians for more than 40 years. With more than a century of combined legal experience, we have secured meaningful compensation for clients in all types of personal injury matters, and our WV Social Security lawyers have obtained benefits for workers who earned them. If you need a West Virginia personal injury attorney for any kind of injury or a lawyer to help guide and advocate for you through the social security process, reach out to schedule a free consultation by calling 304-263-0900 or 800-903-0901, or complete our Martinsburg, WV law firm’s online contact form.
